Subtitles
Class

Cinematic Subtitles and Closed-Captions entity for Retiam scenes. Features crisp SDF typography, mathematically undistorted circular corner fillets, curated design presets (obsidian, pill, minimal, broadcast, neon, glass, light), and fine-grained runtime style options.

TTSNarrationComponent
Class

Retiam ECS Component that empowers any visual Entity with voice narration capabilities. Features automatic speech synthesis with Kokoro-82M (WebGPU) or Microsoft Edge Neural TTS, voiceover ducking, and synchronized micro-interaction visual pulses while speaking.
